run_DFConsole_main_loop: run the DFConsole main loop to start an interactive DarkForest game console with an RL model
convert_move2action: convert a chess-style move string like A1 into a flat action index for the 19x19 board
convert_action2move: convert a flat action index back into a human-readable move string like A1 on the 19x19 board
plot_plane_tensor: plot a 2D tensor plane as an ASCII grid showing occupied and empty cells
compute_topk_accuracy: compute top-k accuracy by comparing model predicted action probabilities against ground truth actions
